stages.name: setup
stages.description: data and models for the probe

steps.name: setup_0
steps.cmd: HF_HUB_OFFLINE=0 python -c "from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download as s; print(s('unsloth/llama-3-8b-Instruct', allow_patterns=['*.json','*.safetensors','tokenizer*']))" | tail -1 > {RESULTS}/llama_path.txt && P=$(cat {RESULTS}/llama_path.txt) && cd {REPO}/LLaMA-Factory-main && ln -sfn $P llama3-8b-instruct && mkdir -p llama_models && ln -sfn $P llama_models/llama3-8b-instruct && ls -la llama3-8b-instruct llama_models

stages.name: probe
stages.description: every documented entry point, README order, minimal sizes

steps.name: 1_sft_ldsm
steps.cmd: cd {REPO}/LLaMA-Factory-main && HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 timeout 3h llamafactory-cli train examples/llama3_lora_sft_ldsm_2.yaml

steps.name: 2_dpo
steps.cmd: cd {REPO}/LLaMA-Factory-main && HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 timeout 3h llamafactory-cli train examples/llama3_lora_dpo.yaml
